title: Oki Shannon on building an anti-gravity device using Ferris Williams' theory

tellings.quote: Shannon is on record saying, "If we were to build an anti-gravitational device, it would be built on the principles involved in William's theory."

plain: A man named Oke Shannon, whom the story ties to Los Alamos National Laboratory, is said to have backed a theory by a man named Ferris Williams as the way to build an anti-gravity machine, a device that would cancel or push against gravity. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, saying Shannon is "on record" with the words: "If we were to build an anti-gravitational device, it would be built on the principles involved in William's theory." If true, it would mean someone at a top US weapons lab took a working path to anti-gravity seriously.
